description: This Java source file defines the implementation of a service that maps business step categories to specific COB (Close of Business) step classes within the Fineract project. It primarily contains a class 'LoanBusinessStepCategoryServiceImpl' that implements an interface 'BusinessStepCategoryService', and manages a static map of categories to step classes. The class provides a method to retrieve the corresponding COB business step class based on a category string.

classes.name: LoanBusinessStepCategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of BusinessStepCategoryService that provides mapping from category strings to COB business step classes, specifically for loan-related categories.

methods.name: getBusinessStepByCategory
methods.description: Returns the COBBusinessStep class corresponding to a given category string by looking it up in a static map.

methods.name: getBusinessStepByCategory
methods.description: Retrieves the COBBusinessStep class mapped to the specified category, or null if none matches.
